dict.string: Grux reads the frontmost app and window title to judge focus.
Grux plays music from your Apple Music library and catalog when you ask it to.
Grux reads your calendar events so the workday log can show which meetings you attended and align them with ambient transcripts.
Grux reads your calendar events so the workday log can show which meetings you attended and align them with ambient transcripts.
Grux reads your contacts so it can look up emails and phone numbers for you and link meeting speakers to real people.
Grux listens on your Wi-Fi so the Grux Phone app on your iPhone can stream audio directly to this Mac. Nothing leaves your network.

Grux uses the microphone for dictation and voice commands. If you turn it on in Settings, it can also listen for a wake word, or continuously transcribe your meetings and conversations. Continuous listening is off by default, and audio is transcribed on this Mac and never uploaded.
Grux watches the screen to keep you on your current focus task and nudge you when you drift.
Grux transcribes your voice into chat so you can talk to your assistant hands-free.
Grux captures system audio (calls, meetings) to transcribe them locally with WhisperKit.
